summary.oneLiner: A heavy and precision steel fabricator manufacturing tubular windmill towers for wind turbine generator OEMs, operating two plants in Koppal (Karnataka) and Kutch (Gujarat).
summary.business: The Company manufactures windmill towers, focusing on fabrication of towers from heavy and precision steel components customized to client requirements in the wind energy sector. Towers are tubular steel structures rolled from heavy steel plates, longitudinally and circumferentially welded and made in multiple cylindrical sections (commonly five, typically 140 metres in height) for road transport and on-site erection using flanges and bolts. currentContext.expansion: The Company operates Unit I at Koppal, Karnataka across approximately 20.75 acres with an installed annual production capacity of 420 windmill towers (up to 35 towers per month). To meet growing demand in the wind energy sector it commenced operations at a new manufacturing facility at Lakadia, Bhachau, Kutch, Gujarat in March 2026, adding production capacity of 16 windmill towers per month.
